key_findings: CBS central Bachelor requirements provide TOEFL 83, IELTS 6.5, and Cambridge B2/C1 for English-taught bachelor programs.
CBS central Master requirements provide TOEFL 92, IELTS 7.0, and Cambridge B2/C1 for English-taught master programs.
The CBS MBA pages do not show GRE/GMAT as an admission requirement; official MBA FAQ instead emphasizes first academic degree, 180 ECTS, and at least one year of work experience.
CBS application flow is digital and generally year-round while places are available; visa-sensitive checklist deadlines appear on the Bachelor/Master requirement pages.
known_gaps: This pass covers seed/finding-relevant detailed programs: B.Sc. International Business, M.Sc. International Business & Management, MBA 120 ECTS, and MBA 60 ECTS.
Other English CBS bachelor/master programs listed on the full-time page were not expanded into records without opening their own program pages.
MBA-specific language certificate thresholds were not found on the reviewed MBA pages, so the MBA language_requirements arrays are intentionally empty.
